from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document record extracted from the corpus."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The official title of the judgment document, e.g., '《判决文书 1》'")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action category this document belongs to, matching the provided task list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
